home.intro: Adalia is a creative artist based in Omaha, NE. She’s known for her ethereal illustrations depicting everyday abstracts. Her work is appreciated for its stunning line accuracy and brilliant water colors.

galleries.title: Digital Illustration
testimonials: “Adalia uses color, form and design to bring joyful and expressive art!! It makes me smile everyday I see it! Her graphic art that represents my business always receives the highest compliments!” - Shannon F

“Adalia has always delivered beautiful work in a timely manner. She has diverse abilities and style. She has done a great job customizing her work to fit my desires. I love seeing all the work she’s done over the years for my wedding shower invites, on business cards, and around my home.” - CJ Radford

“Adalia did a fantastic job designing a logo and graphics for my website! Her lines and shapes formed clear and memorable visuals for my product needs. I would happily recommend her to anyone looking for top-notch digital artwork.” - David S
“Holy moly I love it!! This is the image from my brain space, you captured it beautifully, thank you Adalia!” -Emilee H, Owner of Root to Rise OT

galleries.title: Murals
testimonials: "Adalia was a delight to work with through the whole process of my mural! I needed a mural that fit a specific aesthetic for my shop - flat, graphic & colorful. She helped design, provided a mockup, always arrived on schedule & did the job with craftsmanship & cleanliness. She is very receptive to feedback through her artistic process & asked questions to make sure she was meeting my expectations! The mural has received many compliments & brings so much color & interest to the shop. If you're considering mural artists don't look any further, book with Adalia - you won't regret it!" -  Julia McGuigan Owner of Julia M Illustrates

“Adalia collaborated with us over serval months to adorn our Benson cafe with her ethereal murals. She worked in a variety of mediums to fill the green and purple bathroom walls & ceilings with doodles of everything imaginable and made our wildest dreams for these spaces come true! “ - Adam & Rachel, Owners of Edge of the Universe Café

“Adalia was the first person I thought of when we needed a wall decorated for our wedding. She knows how to capture any vision so well. She even got to the venue early and completed the wall (beyond our wildest dreams amazing). I highly recommend her not only for her artistic and creative abilities, but for her can-do attitude and constant smiles!” - Hannah P

“Adalia painted a tree mural in my bedroom. I love its whimsical design, proportions in my space, and the feeling she created of being in a treehouse. She was able to incorporate materials I had on hand and completed the project within my desired timeline. Adalia is an excellent choice for any of your mural needs!” - Moriah C
We love it. Thank you Adalia! -Mike & Julie, Owners of Automatic Print Company

galleries.title: Portraits
testimonials: “When I met Adalia, I immediately knew she was talented. She drew a custom commission piece of my dad and his mother who passed away. He still cherishes it to this day. She also drew a photo of my husband and I that I’ll personally treasure forever. I will be using her services again and would highly recommend her!” - Rosie G
“I am so pleased with Adalia’s creative watercolor portraits. She chose to emphasize hair and face shapes which made it simple and creatively unique. She is so talented!!” - Heidi F

“We are thrilled with the portrait drawing that Adalia did of my husband and I. We are so impressed with how she captured personality and character with a pencil. We could not ask for higher quality work! It literally is exactly what we were hoping it would be, and somehow even better. Thanks, Adalia.” - Cathie M

“I commissioned Adalia to draw my friend's daughter and her fiancé as a wedding gift. I wanted a gift that was truly unique, personal, and different than any other gift. The finished piece was exquisite! The drawing captured their personalities and love for each other in an amazing way. I could not have found a more perfect present for them and they loved it!” - Jane S
